name: Forgiveness Of Past Sins
overview: The Scriptures reveal that all humanity has sinned and fallen short of God's glory, but through faith in Jesus Christ, believers receive forgiveness for past sins and are justified before God. This forgiveness is granted by God's grace and is accessed through repentance and baptism in the name of Jesus, resulting in the remission of sins and the gift of the Holy Spirit. The assurance of everlasting life and peace with God is secured by trusting in Christ, who was given by God out of love for the world.
